metadata.description: Short lower-case token (3-8 letters or digits) that makes the global names unique. Leave empty to derive 5 characters from the subscription id: that is stable per subscription, so a re-deployment updates the same resources.
Used in resource group names: rg-<namePrefix>-hub, -spoke-a and -spoke-b.
Region of the hub resources (function apps, source vault, storage). It must support Flex Consumption. Leave empty to use the region you selected for the deployment.
Subscription id of the first destination vault. Leave empty to use the hub subscription. Any subscription of the same tenant works; you need Owner or User Access Administrator there.
Region of the first destination vault. Leave empty to use the hub region.
Subscription id of the second destination vault. Leave empty to use the hub subscription.
Region of the second destination vault. Leave empty to use the hub region.
Purge protection on destination vault A. Some landing-zone policies require it. Once on it cannot be turned off.
Purge protection on destination vault B. Off lets the proof of concept be removed completely (purged) after the test.
Value of the owner tag. Empty = no owner tag.
Value of the delete-after tag (a date, yyyy-mm-dd), a reminder that this is a throw-away proof of concept. Empty = no tag.
Receivers of the alert rules, as a JSON array of e-mail addresses (one string per receiver). Empty = no alert rules are created.

TEST ONLY. Object id of the person who runs the test. Gets Key Vault Administrator on the three vaults and read access to the event queues. Leave empty to use whoever starts the deployment. When a service principal or a pipeline deploys, set this and operatorPrincipalType explicitly.
Type of the principal in operatorObjectId. Use ServicePrincipal when a pipeline or an app registration deploys the template.
Folder URL that holds sync/released-package.zip and renew/released-package.zip. Pin it to a tag or commit when you want a reproducible deployment.
NCRONTAB of the sync safety-net sweep. Short, so the test is quick.
NCRONTAB of the renewal sweep. Short, so the test is quick.
App settings of the renewal function. The test CA signs for 30 days after a 20 s simulated validation delay; renewals may follow each other immediately.

metadata.description: Short token that makes the role names unique in the tenant.
Subscriptions in which the importer role may be assigned: the hub subscription plus every subscription that holds a destination vault.

properties.description: Read certificates and import a certificate version into a Key Vault. Cannot delete, purge, back up, restore, or touch keys and secrets.
Read certificates, create a new pending certificate version (CSR) and merge the signed chain. Cannot read private keys, delete, purge, import or change policy of other objects.

metadata.description: Purge protection. Some landing-zone policies require it. Once on it cannot be turned off, and the vault name stays reserved after deletion.
Sandbox only: public endpoint. Production uses private endpoints.
Purge protection. Some landing-zone policies require it. Once on it cannot be turned off, and the vault name stays reserved after deletion.
Sandbox only: public endpoint. Production uses private endpoints.
Short lower-case token (3-8 letters or digits) that makes the global names unique.
public = public endpoints with Azure RBAC (proof of concept). private = no public data-plane access, private endpoints, VNet-integrated function apps (production).
Destination (consumer) vaults as [{ key, uri }]. Only their addresses are needed here.
Purge protection on the source (issuing) vault. Keep true outside a throw-away proof of concept: it cannot be switched off again.
TEST ONLY. Object id of a human who gets Key Vault Administrator on the source vault and can peek at the event queues. Leave empty in production.
Principal type of operatorObjectId: User, Group or ServicePrincipal.
Deploy the renewal function (request / reissue at the CA, merge the signed chain). Without it only the replication runs.
digicert = DigiCert CertCentral API. testca = private test CA kept in the source vault (proof of concept only).
The renewal identity can read only secrets whose name starts with this prefix (the CA API key or test CA bundle). Enforced with an ABAC condition.

Optional (ABAC). When set, the sync identity can read the private key only of certificates whose name starts with this prefix. When empty it can read every secret except those named <caSecretNamePrefix>*.
Extra app settings for the sync function.
Extra app settings for the renewal function: RENEW_*, TESTCA_* or DIGICERT_* settings (DIGICERT_PRODUCT is required for caProvider = digicert).
NCRONTAB of the sync safety-net sweep.
NCRONTAB of the renewal sweep (starts renewals that are due and polls pending orders).
Folder URL that holds sync/released-package.zip and renew/released-package.zip. The Functions service downloads them.
Deploy the code of both apps from packageBaseUri. Set it to false to publish the code yourself (for example when the apps are private-only and the Functions service cannot reach them).
LRS for a proof of concept, ZRS for production.
Receivers of the alert rules. Empty = no alert rules are created.
Resource id of the custom role "KV Certificate Issuer" (created by roles.bicep). Required when enableRenewApp is true.
private mode: subnet that receives the private endpoints.
private mode: { sync, renew } = two subnets delegated to Microsoft.App/environments for the VNet integration of the function apps.
private mode: private DNS zone ids { vault, blob, queue, table, sites }. Leave a value empty when a central policy registers the DNS records.

properties.description: A KVSYNC or KVRENEW line reports a failed copy, a failed renewal, or a renewal blocked by the rate limit.

allOf.query:
AppTraces
| where Message contains "KVSYNC result=failed" or Message contains "KVRENEW result=failed" or Message contains "KVRENEW result=blocked"

properties.displayName: Key Vault certificate sync: no sweep in the last hour
properties.description: The sync function app has not logged a completed timer sweep. The app is stopped, throttled, or cannot start.

properties.displayName: Key Vault certificate renew: no sweep in the last hour
properties.description: The renew function app has not logged a completed timer sweep. The app is stopped, throttled, or cannot start.

properties.displayName: Key Vault certificate sync: a copy is about to expire
properties.description: A certificate copy has fewer days left than REPLICA_WARN_DAYS (default 7), although the sync is up to date. A healthy chain renews and copies long before that, so renewal, the CA or the source tag is stuck.
